title: Run and Tell
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A runner came across the hills
With good news on his way;
"How beautiful his feet," they said,
"He brings us peace today!"

[Chorus]
Run, little feet, and tell the news,
Go carry something true;
When kind and happy words you bring,
They're beautiful feet, too!

[Verse 2]
The watchmen on the city walls
Looked out and saw him run;
They lifted up their voices high
And sang out, every one.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
When Scout found out the hamster's news,
He could not keep it in;
He ran to every table, then
Outside, with one big grin.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So carry something kind and true
To someone far or near;
Good news grows bigger when it's shared,
And beautiful to hear.

[Chorus]
mood: Running music. A light, quick-stepping strum under the voice, like small feet skipping down a hill with news that cannot wait. Soft ukulele keeping the step, an upright bass walking underneath, a plucked little turn between the verses like a wave from the city wall. It gets lighter and quicker with each verse, never louder, until the last chorus is a laugh with words in it.
